2113-4687-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
2113-4687-4929.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

372-4247-6767.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-5686-5933.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1086-1981-2415-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1086-1981-2415-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4050-7498-7541-7574.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least 5 life.
Grave Researcher is prepared.
4050-7498-7541-7574.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Biblioplex Tomekeeper, adding {B}.
Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Cast the copy of Reanimate from exile by paying {B}, returning Biblioplex Tomekeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield and losing 4 life.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Grave Researcher.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1170-4113-7495.description:
Cast All Aboard using the convoke ability from Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia by tapping Skycoach Conductor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Skycoach Conductor, which enters prepared.
Resolve All Aboard.
Repeat.

1512-4222-6006.description:
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster by tapping it, adding {U}.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Repeat.

553-1470-7735.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Quicksilver.
In response, cast Hinder by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

2450-4050-6259-7639.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath by paying {U} due to Samut.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

240-643-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-643-4050.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

2082-3490-6798-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2082-3490-6798-7426.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat

850-1978-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.

5147-5199.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to Saber Ants.
Saber Ants triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-1669-3678.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-3678.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

129-5137-6723.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-5137-6723.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

67-1676-3641-5670-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-3641-5670-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Distinguished Conjurer and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Distinguished Conjurer triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-3641-5670-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

3240-3967-4871-6560.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1029-5028-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Bighorner Rancher.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-5028-5614.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

2178-2511-5173-6095.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
2178-2511-5173-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

654-1170-3389-5334-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1309-2254-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 1 or less.
1309-2254-5626.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Salvager of Secrets, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Salvager of Secrets's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Salvager of Secrets from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

658-3544-3771-4050-5751.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
658-3544-3771-4050-5751.description:
Cast Auramancer from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {W} and discarding Urza's Saga.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Urza's Saga from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Auramancer, adding {W}.
Repeat.

3470-5413-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
3470-5413-5720-5721.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Lotus Cobra's trigger.

1247-4044-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Pili-Pala, adding {C}{C}.
When Pili-Pala dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Pili-Pala on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Pili-Pala from the top of your library by paying {2}.
Repeat.

423-511-2397-3510.notablePrerequisites: Sporoloth Ancient has at least three spore counters on it.
423-511-2397-3510.description:
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Life and Limb, Evolution Sage triggers twice, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

377-2427-2640-4050-4564.notablePrerequisites: Everflame Eidolon attached to Nyxborn Shieldmate.
377-2427-2640-4050-4564.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nyxborn Shieldmate, adding {W}.
Nyxborn Shieldmate leaves the battlefield, causing Everflame Eidolon to become an enchantment creature.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Nyxborn Shieldmate from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Nyxborn Shieldmate for its bestow cost by paying {W}, attaching it to Everflame Eidolon.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Everflame Eidolon, adding {R}.
Everflame Eidolon leaves the battlefield, causing Nyxborn Shieldmate to become an enchantment creature.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Everflame Eidolon from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Everflame Eidolon for its bestow cost by paying {R}, attaching it to Nyxborn Shieldmate.
Repeat.

2608-4149-4283-4364.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Derevi.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2608-4149-4283-4364.description:
Declare Aurelia and Derevi as attackers.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Aurelia, creating at least three 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing two Zombies, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Deal combat damage with Derevi, triggering its ability, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-4681-4881.description:
Cast Activated Sleeper by paying {2}{B}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Activated Sleeper trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, targeting Activated Sleeper.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2187-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab with haste.
The token copy of Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2281-2533.notablePrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2281-2533.description:
Sacrifice Saffi Eriksdotter targeting Loyal Retainers.
Sacrifice Loyal Retainers to return Saffi to the battlefield.
Return Loyal Retainers to the battlefield.
Repeat.

225-3525-3664.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
225-3525-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.

483-1580-2034-2530.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}.
Reassembling Skeleton dies, triggering Cruel Celebrant, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Cast Reassembling Skeleton from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield triggering Carnival of Souls, causing you to lose 1 life and adding {B}.
Repeat.
